Composition: TWO complete desktop app windows stacked vertically on a portrait 3:4 design board. Each window should retain believable 1440x900 desktop proportions and readable Chinese. Other owned pets include 小蓝 and 饭团 (separate instances), orange shiba 焰柴 and tuxedo cat 礼帽喵. No technical architecture labels inside the product. No code, watermark or decorative dashboard KPIs. Design at high fidelity, with sharp Chinese text and high-quality consistent character illustration.
